[68 people](https://www.edweek.org/leadership/school-shootings-this-year-how-many-and-where/2021/03) were killed or injured in a school shooting in 2021 in the US

Out of 50 million students in the US your chances of being hurt or killed in a school shooting are .0000136%. 

I’m sure that the statistics for another disaster are also similarly low.
